mapper.select: select * from category where type = #{type} and user_id is null order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into category (name, icon, type, sort_order, is_default, user_id, create_time) values (#{name}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{sortOrder}, #{isDefault}, #{userId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update category set name = #{category.name}, icon = #{category.icon}, sort_order = #{category.sortOrder} where id = #{category.id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from category where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from category where user_id = #{userId}
